specsRaw.Safe Finish Preservation: Mild, neutral formulation removes grease, sweat, and debris without damaging delicate coatings, polished surfaces, or anti-reflective crystal treatments.
specsRaw.Crevice-Flush Cleansing: Penetrates deep between bracelet links, bezel ridges, and case backs to dissolve hidden grime that causes premature wear and "wrist bite."
specsRaw.Streak-Free Luster: Dries quickly and cleanly to eliminate smudges, restore depth to dials, and bring out the high-polish shine of fine metals.
specsRaw.Precision-Controlled Care: Applied via spray or soft-bristle brush, giving you total control near crowns and pushers while preventing liquid intrusion.
specsRaw.Hypoallergenic Shield: Safely lifts skin acids and bacterial buildup from metal and rubber surfaces, protecting both your watch and your skin during daily wear.
specsRaw.Quick / Daily Maintenance (56 to 75 Clea: Uses 3 to 4 sprays total (1–2 for the watch case, 2 for the bracelet/clasp). Ideal for clearing daily smudges, fingerprints, and light surface dust.
specsRaw.Deep Cleans & Grime Removal (28 to 45 Cl: Uses 5 to 8 sprays total. Ideal for flushing out built-up wrist oils, sweat, and debris trapped inside bracelet links, clasp folds, and bezel ridges.

watches.name: Oshoro Dive Watch in Abyss Blue
watches.description: Built for underwater performance, the Oshoro Collection is engineered as a professional dive watch with capability at its core. Designed to perform in demanding conditions, it combines technical precision with purposeful design to deliver confidence at depth and versatility in everyday wear. Its 316L stainless steel case is built for strength, corrosion resistance and lasting comfort. Defined by balanced proportions and refined finishing, it offers a strong presence on the wrist while remaining practical for daily use. The dial is designed for immediate legibility. Applied indices and distinctive hands ensure clear reading in changing conditions, with a clean and functional layout that prioritises clarity above all else. Water resistant to 300 metres (1,000 feet), the Oshoro Collection is built to meet the demands of serious diving. The unidirectional rotating bezel allows precise measurement of elapsed time and provides dependable operation when timing matters. Finished with a choice of bracelet or strap, the watch is designed to deliver security, comfort and adaptability across environments. Powering the Oshoro Collection is the regulated and custom-decorated ES-M9015 automatic movement, selected for its proven reliability, accuracy and long-term performance. Visible through the sapphire case back, the movement reflects Emerton Scott’s commitment to engineering, refinement and enduring craftsmanship. As part of our commitment to continuous improvement, subtle updates to the Oshoro Collection will be introduced over time to further refine performance and execution.

watches.name: Masora GMT Timepiece in Eclipse Green
watches.description: Built for the modern explorer, the Masora GMT is designed to move seamlessly between worlds—where precision engineering meets purposeful design. Its 316L stainless steel case is crafted for durability and refinement, with a balanced profile that delivers both presence with everyday wearability and comfort. Born from the tension between our limits and the depths we explore to transcend them, the Masroa GMT dial symbolises a beautiful ocean of clouds. Applied indices and distinctive hands provide clarity in all conditions, while the GMT function introduces a second time zone. An essential companion for those operating across borders, time zones, and disciplines. Engineered for performance, the Masora GMT is equipped with a unidirectional bezel and robust 150m water resistance, ensuring reliability whether in motion or at rest. The refined design flows effortlessly into a choice of bracelet or strap, reinforcing both comfort and versatility. At its core lies the regulated and custom-decorated ES-M9075 automatic movement, chosen for its reliability and precision. Elevated through finishing details that reflect Emerton Scott's commitment to craftsmanship. Visible through the sapphire case back, it represents the union of technical mastery and considered design. As part of our ongoing pursuit of refinement, subtle updates to the Masora GMT will continue to be introduced over time to make the timepiece better.

watches.name: Masora GMT Timepiece in Auray White
watches.description: Built for the modern explorer, the Masora GMT is designed to move seamlessly between worlds—where precision engineering meets purposeful design. Its 316L stainless steel case is crafted for durability and refinement, with a balanced profile that delivers both presence with everyday wearability and comfort. Born from the tension between our limits and the depths we explore to transcend them, the Masroa GMT dial symbolises a beautiful ocean of clouds. Applied indices and distinctive hands provide clarity in all conditions, while the GMT function introduces a second time zone. An essential companion for those operating across borders, time zones, and disciplines. Engineered for performance, the Masora GMT is equipped with a unidirectional bezel and robust 150m water resistance, ensuring reliability whether in motion or at rest. watches.name: Porterfield Triple Watch Travel Case
watches.description: The Porterfield Triple Watch Travel Case is designed for the modern collector who values both elegance and protection. Crafted from durable PU leather, it combines a smooth, premium finish with resilient construction, keeping your watches safe without compromising style. Inside, a soft linen lining cushions each timepiece, preventing scratches and ensuring your collection remains flawless while traveling. The pouch features a secure closure for reliable fastening, giving you peace of mind wherever you go. Lightweight and compact, the Porterfield slips effortlessly into bags or luggage, keeping your watches organized without adding bulk. Subtle detailing and refined materials create a timeless, sophisticated finish that complements any style. With anti-scratch design, soft lining protection, and premium materials throughout, the Porterfield Watch Travel Case unites practicality with understated luxury — the perfect companion for your timepieces on every journey. *Designed to securely carry up to three timepieces at a time.

watches.name: Setsuna Timepiece in Auroro White & 9k Champagne Gold
watches.description: The Setsuna Collection is inspired by the serene beauty of Kyoto’s Zen gardens. The dial’s subtle textures mirror flowing lines of raked sand, a symbol of harmony, reflection, and balance. As light moves across the surface, the dial reveals subtle depth and quiet rhythm. Symbolising of in the meaning of setsuna — a reminder to be present in the moment and that peace of mind is essential to reach out optimal potential. The moon phase complication connects the wearer to the quiet rhythm of the heavens. With graceful precision, it reflects the lunar cycle as the moon gradually emerges. Beyond its technical beauty, the moon phase serves as a subtle reminder of time’s natural cadence. Just as the raked sand patterns shift with intention, the moon moves through its phases with quiet inevitability, marking the passage of each moment. The Setsuna's 37mm case diameter and 11mm slim profile in 9k Champagne Gold is both refined and resilient. Smooth polished contours and brushed gold reflect balance and restraint, embodying the harmony between strength and elegance. The Setsuna is powered by the ES-M9015-CM automatic movement. Operating at 28,800 vibrations per hour and finished with Geneva waves and blued screws, the calibre is revealed through a sapphire case back — uniting Japanese precision with Emerton Scott’s vision of harmonising craftsmanship, engineering, and mindful design. Built upon the reliable Miyota 9015 automatic movement, the calibre is customised by our partners to incorporate an elegant moon phase complication.
